1.2.0

Added a Gravity toggle below the character portraits when starting a new run. Turn it off to use the normal map and travel rules. Your choice is remembered; in co-op, the host chooses for everyone.

────────────────────

开始新冒险时，可通过角色头像下方的 Gravity 开关启用或停用模组。关闭后使用原版地图和行进规则。你的选择会自动保存；联机时由房主为所有玩家选择。
